evidence_classes.decision_hardware: Observed IBM SamplerV2 archives under decision-study/data/raw/.
evidence_classes.post_collection_policy_replay: New analysis of already-collected shots; not a new QPU job.

ghz_jobs.csv.hellinger_vs_exact_ghz_baseline: Separate exact 000/111 split; not a substitute for Aer.

job_level.csv.charged_usage_seconds: Reconciled IBM QPU charge for the job.
job_level.csv.client_dispatch_utc: Client created_utc in the raw archive; not IBM metrics.timestamps.created.
job_level.csv.missing: null if a provider timestamp was absent.

policy_level.csv.independent_strict_improvement: Recomputed from business utility versus greedy incumbent.
policy_level.csv.strict_improvement_field: Value returned by frozen apply_policy. P0 does not populate this field; do not treat missing as measured zero.

pub_level.csv.absolute_optimality_gap: exact_optimum - best_feasible_utility; null if no feasible shot (not observed).
pub_level.csv.feasible_shot_fraction: Feasible shots / 1024. Denominator is all shots, including infeasible.
pub_level.csv.optimal_hit_fraction: Shots equal to an exact optimum bitstring / 1024.
pub_level.csv.unit: one PUB = one fixture × depth inside one block
